name: dialog-03
title: Dialog with Input Field
description: A dialog with input field block.

standards.purpose: Interrupt for one decision that cannot be handled inline.
useWhen: The user must confirm, choose, or enter something before continuing.
doNotUseWhen: The content is long-form or navigational — use a page or sheet.

rules.check: Every dialog has an accessible title; an icon alone is not a label.
Destructive confirmations use an alert dialog with a clearly named confirm action.
A dialog never opens another dialog.
Focus moves into the dialog on open and returns to the trigger on close.
